actions.askQuestion.description: Ask a question to a specific bot in a specific team.
actions.askQuestion.props.autocut.descri: Autocut results to num groups. Optional, defaults to false.
Number of sources to lookup for the bot to answer from. Optional, default is 5. Research mode uses 16 (more expensive token usage).
actions.askQuestion.props.default_langua: The default language to use if the language of the conversation is unclear. Use locale codes like 'en' or 'en-US'. Optional, defaults to the bot's configured language.
actions.askQuestion.props.document_retri: Whether to use the document retriever for this question. Optional, default is false.
actions.askQuestion.props.followup_ratin: Whether to ask the user for a follow-up rating after the question is answered. Optional, default is false.
actions.askQuestion.props.full_source.de: Whether to return the full source content in the response. Optional, default is false.
actions.askQuestion.props.human_escalati: Whether to enable human escalation for this question. Optional, default is false.
actions.askQuestion.props.image_urls.des: List of image URLs to include with the question as context. Optional, defaults to null.
actions.askQuestion.props.metadata.descr: A user identification object with arbitrary metadata about the user. Will be saved to the question and conversation. Keys referrer, email, and name are shown in question history logs. Optional, defaults to null.
actions.askQuestion.props.model.descript: Override the model used for this request. Requires an OpenAI API key to be set on your team. Optional, defaults to the model configured for the bot.
actions.askQuestion.props.question.descr: The question to ask the bot. 2 to 500 characters. Max increased to 8K tokens (roughtly 32k chars) when authenticated.
actions.askQuestion.props.reasoning_effo: Reasoning depth for the response. Requires authentication to override default.
actions.askQuestion.props.testing.descri: Whether the request is for testing purposes. Optional, defaults to false.
actions.createBot.props.copyFrom.descrip: The ID of an existing bot in your team to copy from. If provided, the new bot will be created as a copy of the specified bot, with all sources copied over after creation.
actions.createBot.props.description.desc: The bot description. Shown by default in embeds and share links.
actions.createBot.props.embeddingModel.d: The embedding model. Currently supports text-embedding-ada-002, text-embedding-3-large, text-embedding-3-small, embed-multilingual-v3.0, and embed-v4.0 (Cohere) depending on your plan.
actions.createBot.props.privacy.descript: The bot privacy. Can be public or private.
actions.createSource.description: Create a new source for a bot.
actions.createSource.props.type.descript: Can be url, document, sitemap, wp, urls, csv, rss, qa, youtube. All but url, sitemap, and youtube require uploading a formatted file.
actions.custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
actions.custom_api_call.props.failsafe.d: On a failed request, output the error instead of failing the step.
actions.custom_api_call.props.followRedi: Follow 3xx redirects instead of returning them as the response.
actions.custom_api_call.props.headers.de: Authorization headers are injected automatically from your connection.
actions.custom_api_call.props.response_i: Enable for files like PDFs, images, etc.
actions.custom_api_call.props.timeout.de: Seconds to wait for a response. Empty: up to the flow limit (10 min).
actions.uploadSourceFile.description: Upload a file to be used as a source.
auth.description: The API key for authenticating with DocsBot.
description: DocsBot AI allows you to build AI-powered chatbots that pull answers from your existing documentation and content. This integration enables workflows to ask DocsBot questions and update its training sources dynamically.
